info.name: HRMS Platform — Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the HRMS Platform. All services, all endpoints.

**Setup:**
1. Set collection variable `tenant_id` = `demo`
2. Run '01 Login as Admin' first — access_token will auto-save
3. All subsequent requests use {{access_token}} automatically

**Base URLs:**
- Via Gateway (recommended): http://localhost:8080
- Auth direct: http://localhost:8081
- Core HR direct: http://localhost:8082
